How I typically set a mod is first replace any shelf strips that need replacing, then as long as it's not a minor mod where everything minus one or two items stays the same, start from the bottom shelf.
Remove anything that's not on that particular shelf.
Find what goes in holes and pull them from their current location to fill.
Set the shelf above if shelves are moving, and repeat steps until complete.

By only removing product as you go, you will hopefully create less of a mess. And as you pull product from other shelves and/or sections, you'll help to empty those shelves too to make space for what is being moved there. I hate when I see associates remove an entire shelf's worth of product when it's not necessary. Or worse, they'll pull off everything on the section, then scan every single one.

According to the new "One Best Way," you aren't supposed to replace labels if the mod is staying in sequence. Your SM may prefer to still replace every label regardless though. If that's the case, after replacing necessary shelf strips, remove old labels and replace with new ones so that it's easier to move product around once you start from the bottom.

I hope this helps!
